justification: Terry's banged up and that game's already off and running without him, so he comes out of the FLEX and Puka Nacua goes in — full go this week, practiced all week, no tag next to his name, and I believe a healthy man over a maybe every time. Everywhere else the room stayed the same: Daniel's earned another week under center, Hampton and Corum keep carrying the load, Wan'Dale and Amon-Ra both showed up and produced last Sunday so they start again, and Mark Andrews gets his third straight look after finding a few catches last week. We're 0-3 and I know what the box score says, but this group's still competing snap to snap, and that's the only thing I've ever built a program on. Clear eyes, full hearts — we go again Sunday.
